# MIDAS Equation
Original MIDAS equation
$$
y_t = \beta_0 + \sum_{k=0}^{K} \beta(k;\theta)\, x_{t-k/m} + \varepsilon_t
$$

## MIDAS Matrix Form

$$
\begin{bmatrix}
y_1 \\[4pt]
\vdots \\[4pt]
y_n
\end{bmatrix}
=
\begin{bmatrix}
1 & x_{1-0/m} & x_{1-1/m} & \cdots & x_{1-K/m} \\[4pt]
1 & x_{2-0/m} & x_{2-1/m} & \cdots & x_{2-K/m} \\[4pt]
\vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\[4pt]
1 & x_{n-0/m} & x_{n-1/m} & \cdots & x_{n-K/m}
\end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix}
\beta_0 \\[4pt]
\beta(0;\theta) \\[4pt]
\beta(1;\theta) \\[4pt]
\vdots \\[4pt]
\beta(K;\theta)
\end{bmatrix}
+
\begin{bmatrix}
\varepsilon_1 \\[4pt]
\vdots \\[4pt]
\varepsilon_n
\end{bmatrix}.
$$

MIDAS r without trend
$$
y_t = \beta_0 + \phi\, y_{t-2} + \sum_{k=0}^{K} \beta(k;\theta)\, x_{t-k/m} + \varepsilon_t
$$

MIDAS r with trend
$$
y_t = \beta_0 + \phi\, y_{t-2} + \delta\, t + \sum_{k=0}^{K} \beta(k;\theta)\, x_{t-k/m} + \varepsilon_t
$$
